06ea9f2327ee4cc2.text: {"thought": "The base run falls to 31.4 kt. The shoal effect is what hides the decline from the fleet, so a weaker one is the likeliest way to break the claim. Try the low end of its range.", "tool": "extreme", "args": {"parameter": "shoal_concentration", "value": 0.5}}

42eca400324bdf47.text: {"thought": "Fast regrowth alone barely helps: 33.8 kt. A slower boom might stop short of a collapse; try the low end of investment_sensitivity.", "tool": "extreme", "args": {"parameter": "investment_sensitivity", "value": 0.125}}

a06dc1fb7e9c48db.text: {"thought": "The lowest stock is now far above 100 kt, so the claim fails here. Check that this is not an artefact of the time step.", "tool": "halve_dt", "args": {"settings": {"shoal_concentration": 0.5, "regrowth_rate": 0.45}}}
a06dc1fb7e9c48db.how: written for the book with claude-opus-5-5 (no live API call)

5250c453640b9db0.text: {"thought": "Halving dt moves the lowest stock by about 1 kt, so the result is not numerical. The claim does not hold everywhere in the ranges.", "answer": {"holds": false, "case": {"tool": "simulate", "args": {"settings": {"shoal_concentration": 0.5, "regrowth_rate": 0.45}}}, "report": "One parameter at a time, the claim holds at every end I tried; the closest was shoal_concentration 0.5, with a lowest stock of 90.5 kt. With shoal_concentration 0.5 and regrowth_rate 0.45 together, the lowest stock is 317.4 kt and the stock is 419.0 kt in year 50, so there is no collapse. Halving the time step moves that lowest stock only from 316.3 to 317.4 to 317.9 kt, so the result is real: the collapse depends on a strong shoal effect."}}
